scope: Independent source review of four fixed full-count control replays. The ongoing data replay and its later audit are separate.
review: The input audit, complete original data/source hash maps and 576-path matrix are checked. No simulator or true parameters are passed into replay_history, replay_method or endpoint prediction.

Coarse schedule_blocks combines the first 16 observed pairs into one 32-shot block. Its initial safe prediction therefore receives empty paid rows and center 0.5. Partial observed tails before 32 remain unconsumed.

Fine safe predictions use precisely the paid rows from preceding fine blocks. The current prediction and safe update occur before the current observations are merged into the paid-row store. Logged previous-paid-shot counts must equal the state budget.

Four methods have separate states and own first certified stopping prefixes. Both schedules use the same underlying observed category counts at their eligible checkpoints. Later original-path observations do not replace a stopped method prefix.
Endpoint predictions use the frozen fit and rational endpoint precision; all engines retain the exact same 71 normalized reciprocal-odds experts. This changes no frozen odds or prior weights.

Each eligible screen uses the frozen tolerance followed by its outward certificate, and cap certificates are forced. A result becomes a stop only at the first non-abstaining certified direction or an observed cap abstention.

Unobserved continuation is not imputed. If a method remains active, its lower cost is the next method checkpoint strictly after the actual original-path end and its upper cost is 4096. The last eligible prefix and any unconsumed initial coarse tail are recorded separately.
Summaries retain every case, error, cap abstention and censored path. Reported cost ranges are equal-case ratios of possible within-case mean costs, not statistical confidence intervals.

The deterministic interface checks cover current-outcome mutation without prediction change, exact paid-prefix timing, coarse aggregation, partial-tail censoring, observed-cap abstention and mirrored first stopping directions.
limits: This review confirms source logic, not completion of the 2304-record data reconstruction or its independent audit.
Predictability does not make replayed development data a held-out test. No inferential superiority or empirical 1% error guarantee is obtained.
The four methods remain separately evaluated frozen controls. Their first-crossing union is not a new certified combined procedure.
Right-censored control costs must remain intervals; replacing them with cap values would change the comparison.
